[Super Bowl LX] Super Bowl LX was an American football game played to determine the champion of the National Football League (NFL) for the 2025 season. The National Football Conference (NFC) champion Seattle Seahawks defeated the American Football Conference (AFC) champion New England Patriots 29–13. The game took place on February 8, 2026, at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara, California, the second Super Bowl held in the stadium and the third held in the San Francisco Bay Area. The Seahawks' victory was their second, previously having won 2013's Super Bowl XLVIII during their Legion of Boom era. Led by their Dark Side defense, they were making their fourth appearance with a 14–3 record and the NFC's top seed. The Patriots, who finished with a 14–3 record and the AFC's second seed, extended their record of appearances to 12. They were seeking a record seventh title and their first since the Brady–Belichick era after last winning 2018's Super Bowl LIII. The two franchises previously met in Super Bowl XLIX, which was won by the Patriots. Seattle scored the only points of the first three quarters, converting four field goals to take a 12–0 lead. In the fourth quarter, the Seahawks scored the first touchdown of the game before the Patriots responded with their own touchdown to cut the score to 19–7. A series of New England turnovers, however, allowed the Seahawks to score 10 consecutive points and put the game out of reach. With the loss, the Patriots became the first team to lose six Super Bowls.  | other articles: 2026–27 NCAA football bowl games, List of Super Bowl champions

[The Mosquito Bowl] The Mosquito Bowl is an upcoming American war film directed by Peter Berg and produced by Film 44 and Imagine Entertainment for Netflix. It is based on the 2022 Buzz Bissinger book The Mosquito Bowl: A Game of Life and Death in World War II, about the Mosquito Bowl game played during World War II. The film stars Nicholas Galitzine, Bill Skarsgård, Ray Nicholson, and Tom Francis in the leading roles. The film had its world premiere at the 2026 AFI Film Festival on October 22, 2026, before getting released in United States theaters on October 30, 2026. | other articles: 2026–27 NCAA football bowl games, 2026 Peach Bowl

[2026 United Bowl] The 2026 United Bowl was the third championship of the United Football League, and it was the first to be played under the United Bowl name. The game was played on June 13, 2026, at Audi Field in Washington, D.C.. The contest determined the champion of the 2026 UFL season and was played between the Louisville Kings and the DC Defenders. The game began at 3:00 p.m. EDT and aired on ABC. The Kings won 27–20, earning their first United Bowl title. | other articles: List of Super Bowl champions, Super Bowl LX
